ballotMeasures.title: 2026 Midterm · Georgia Amendment 1: Conservation use property acreage limit
ballotMeasures.summary:
Shall the Constitution of Georgia, for the purpose of protecting family farmland, be amended so as to increase the maximum acreage to qualify for assessment and taxation as a bona fide conservation use property from 2,000 acres to 4,000 acres?

In short: Raises the maximum acreage of a single owner's agricultural and timber land that can qualify for reduced conservation-use property tax assessment from 2,000 to 4,000 acres.

Official ballot language. Source: https://www.columbiacountyga.gov/DocumentCenter/View/10734

ballotMeasures.title: 2026 Midterm · Georgia Amendment 2: Nonpartisan election of probate judges
ballotMeasures.summary:
Shall the Constitution of Georgia be amended so as to require that all probate court judges be elected in nonpartisan elections?

In short: Requires that all probate court judges in Georgia be elected in nonpartisan elections rather than with party labels.

Official ballot language. Source: https://www.columbiacountyga.gov/DocumentCenter/View/10734

ballotMeasures.title: 2026 Midterm · Georgia Amendment 3: Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund
ballotMeasures.summary:
Shall the Constitution of Georgia be amended so as to authorize the General Assembly to dedicate certain existing revenues, including revenues reallocated by law, to a nonlapsing fund to be used exclusively for the expansion, maintenance, and operation of emergency 9-1-1 systems in this state?

In short: Allows the legislature to create a Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund and dedicate certain existing revenues to it, to be spent only on 9-1-1 systems.

Official ballot language. Source: https://www.columbiacountyga.gov/DocumentCenter/View/10734
